events.title: Swiss Market Ends Modestly Higher
events.description: The Switzerland market ended modestly higher on Friday, after moving in a narrow range in positive territory right through the session. Lower oil prices and bond yields amid hopes about potential opening of the Strait of Hormuz in seven days lifted investor sentiment.

events.title: European Stocks Rise On Oil Decline, Middle East Peace Hopes
events.description: European stocks rose Friday following a more than 2% decline in Brent crude futures and falling bond yields, supported by reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to end Middle East hostilities. Major indices including the DAX and FTSE 100 posted modest gains.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Sentiment Drops Less Than Previously Estimated In September
events.description: Revised data released by the University of Michigan on Friday showed consumer sentiment in the U.S. deteriorated by less than previously estimated in the month of September. The University of Michigan said its consumer sentiment index for September was upwardly revised to 48.1 from a preliminary reading of 47.8.

events.title: Bay Street Poised For Positive Open On Metal Gains
events.description: Higher gold and silver futures support Canadian stock sentiment Friday morning. Iranian officials have submitted peace proposals to U.S. mediators this week. BlackBerry's adjusted net income rose 79% to $43.2 mln in the second quarter.

events.title: U.S. Durable Goods Orders Unexpectedly Unchanged In August
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Friday showed new orders for U.S. manufactured durable goods unexpectedly came in nearly flat in the month of August.

events.title: FTSE 100 Edges Higher On Mining, Banking Strength
events.description: Mining and banking sectors led the FTSE 100 higher by 27.95 points Friday, while energy stocks fell amid renewed Middle East peace proposals. Brent crude dropped nearly 2% to $98.34 per barrel as markets anticipate potential Strait of Hormuz reopening.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Falls As Crude Oil Prices Slide
events.description: The Canadian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as the crude oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: CAC 40 Pares Early Gains, Down Marginally
events.description: France's equity benchmark CAC 40 pared early gains and slipped slightly below the flat line Friday afternoon, despite weak oil prices and lower bond yields amid renewed hopes of a potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: DAX Gains On Crude Pullback, Iran Peace Proposal News
events.description: German stocks gained Friday as weak crude prices and lower bond yields supported sentiment amid renewed hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening. The DAX benchmark climbed 184.58 points to 25,440.50. Energy and financial stocks led gains while HelloFresh tanked 12% after trimming FY26 outlook.

events.title: Indian Shares Stage Late Recovery To End Modestly Higher
events.description: Indian shares fluctuated before finishing modestly higher on Friday, as a sell-off in government debt eased and oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Oil Prices And Yields Ease
events.description: Gold prices rose toward $4,300 an ounce on Friday as a sell-off in government debt eased and oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: Oil Prices Ease On US-Iran Breakthrough Hopes
events.description: Oil prices retreated from recent highs on Friday following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher On US-Iran Truce Hopes
events.description: European stocks advanced on Friday and were on course for a weekly gain as a sell-off in government debt eased and oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
